verdict.line: You lose if Renekton dumps a full empowered combo on you before you hit level 6; you win any fight that lasts past 4 seconds once Indestructible and Realm of Death are online.

brief.thesis: Renekton's entire threat is front-loaded into his Fury bar and his level 3-5 all-in window, before Mordekaiser has access to Realm of Death. Mordekaiser's kit is built for the opposite: W (Indestructible) converts incoming burst into a shield and R (Realm of Death) isolates the fight so it lasts long enough for that shield and later omnivamp to win. The 52.5% win rate over 672 games reflects that whoever controls fight duration controls the lane, and Mordekaiser controls it from level 6 onward.

theirWindow.when: Fury bar full before you hit level 6
theirWindow.what: This is his all-in: empowered E (Slice and Dice) hits twice and empowered W (Ruthless Predator) stuns. Do not stand in dash range at full HP without a plan; back off to minion-block range or force him to spend E on the wave first.

yourWindow.when: His E (Slice and Dice) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no gap-close or escape. Walk him down with Q (Obliterate) and E (Death's Grasp) poke, or from level 6 on, drop R (Realm of Death) to trap him for the full fight.

start.why: 51.6% win rate over 593 games and the highest pick rate (71.5%) — the mana and sustain let you spam Q (Obliterate) poke without getting outlasted in short trades.

boots.why: 83.7% pick rate at 51.6% win rate. Flat armor blunts his auto-attack-reliant empowered combo, though remember his W's execute-style true damage component still gets through — don't treat armor as a full answer.

core.why: HP and a slow that keeps him inside your E (Death's Grasp) range so he can't just walk away once Fury is down
omnivamp turns every extended fight into a race you win, since your kit is built to make fights long
burn scales against the HP he stacks from his own kit and any Thornmail/tank items he buys back

situational.when: you expect his level 3-5 all-in and need armor online before you close in, per the matchup's own tip
he's leaning on sustained auto-attacks or lifesteal to win extended fights
you want more value out of your W shield and Riftmaker omnivamp in a longer game
the game has gone long and you need more mobility to reposition R (Realm of Death) engages

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror rewards exactly the kind of prolonged, melee-range skirmish Mordekaiser wants — it ramps through the fight while Renekton's burst is already spent.

summoners.why: Highest win rate (51.3%) and by far the highest pick rate (78.8%) in this matchup — Ignite punishes his all-in attempts and secures kills once your shield wins the sustained trade.

playing.title: Track the Fury bar, not the clock
playing.detail: Never stand in E range with a full-HP Renekton once his Fury bar is capped pre-6 — that's the all-in, not a random trade.

playing.title: Poke at max Q range
playing.detail: Use Q (Obliterate)'s delayed slam from max range before level 6 rather than walking up, since his E dash punishes short-range trades.

playing.title: Zone with E, build passive
playing.detail: E (Death's Grasp) both chips him and builds Darkness Rises stacks — use it on cooldown to poke instead of saving it purely for all-ins.

playing.title: Save R for fight duration, not burst
playing.detail: Realm of Death isn't a kill button, it's a lock — drop it once you're already winning the exchange so he can't disengage or get peeled.

playing.title: Punish his E cooldown window
playing.detail: The moment Slice and Dice is down, he has no escape — this is when you should initiate, not wait for him to reset.

playing.title: Don't over-invest in pure armor
playing.detail: His reinforced W partially bypasses armor with true damage, so treat Bramble Vest/Steelcaps as a buffer against autos, not a full counter.

playing.title: Flip to initiating at 9+
playing.detail: Once Rylai's and Riftmaker are up, start fights yourself — his damage window is over and your shield plus omnivamp win any extended trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build path, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Purchase Bramble Vest and other items that increase armor before closing in to fight Renekton. Keep in mind that his reinforced (W) can go through armor.
